name: foreign-trade-email-assistant
description: Optional compatibility router that returns complete-thread work to the governed workflow and forwards only bound candidate revisions to customer communication.

interface.shortDescription: Route legacy email requests into the governed customer workflow.
interface.longDescription: A compatibility router for older email-assistant entrypoints. Complete threads, replies, and serious cases return to the workflow director and customer operations before any wording is prepared. Only a bound revision of an existing communication candidate may enter customer communication directly.
defaultPrompt: Route this complete customer email thread into the governed customer workflow.
Route this bounded revision request for an existing communication candidate.
